The '''''Lancer''''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]].

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], it was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tirossk]] and participated in the infamous [[Battle of Mindor]].

==Description==
The ''Lancer'' was a decrepit Corellian frigate. The crew gave her the affectionate nickname "Old Cuss 'n' Whack", these being the two foremost ways of repairing her.

Before coming into the service of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]], the ''Lancer'' served as a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|heavy freighter]], regularly transferring cargo along a conveyor bridge between other starships. This cargo conveyor bridge was retained on the ''Lancer'' even after its expensive military retrofit, being the pivotal feature of the frigate that allowed it to airlift civilians from [[Shadow Base]] during the Battle of Mindor.<ref>[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]</ref>
